description: This file defines API route handlers for managing 'plans' and associated 'goals' within a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints to list and create plans, as well as list and create goals within a specific plan. It relies on external modules for authentication, database interaction via a Supabase client, and data schemas.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI routing object used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: list_plans( authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all plans for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: create_plan( payload: PlanCreate, authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new plan for the current user.

methods.name: list_goals( plan_id: int, authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all goals within a specific plan.

methods.name: create_goal( plan_id: int, payload: GoalCreate, authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new goal within a specific plan.
